summary: Facepalm: No candidates submitted. After many searches I found no facepalm story that met every rule. The search tool returned few usable pages from accepted publishers. It hit its use limit before I could check the leads that looked promising. Genius: No candidate cleared the rules for the genius side on 2026-11-22. I ran about 25 searches. Most useful results were Wikipedia pages, reposts, or sources not on the accepted list. No facepalm story met the standard; nothing published.

candidates.headline: Hannah Lillith Assadi's 'Paradiso 17' wins the 2026 National Book Award for fiction in New York
Roselle, N.J., welcome banner misspells 'visiting' as 'visivting'
candidates.reason: The banner went up and was fixed in late September to early October, outside the 7-day window. The sources found were News 12, TAPinto and a Yahoo copy, none of them accepted.

candidates.headline: Wayne County, Mich., payroll error deposits $1.6 million in one paycheck
candidates.reason: This is a routine payroll error from 2025, so it is far too old.

candidates.headline: Boston mayor's office mistakenly sends 'electeds of color' party invitation to the whole council
candidates.reason: The error was in December 2023, so it is too old.

candidates.headline: Buffalo city workers cut down a couple's willow tree by mistake
candidates.reason: Only WKBW was found and the event date was not confirmed. The couple are on the receiving end of the error.

candidates.headline: Albemarle County, Va., schools close after finding 500 staff were never screened for child abuse
candidates.reason: The page could not be fetched, so the event date and details could not be verified. It is also a child-safety matter.

candidates.headline: Junction City, Ky., mayor resigns after a hot-mic video with a slur
candidates.reason: The conduct involves a slur and offence to a group, and the only coverage found was not from an accepted publisher.

candidates.headline: American Airlines marks passengers as no-shows despite boarding photos
candidates.reason: Passengers are on the receiving end of the error, and the only coverage found was a travel blog.

candidates.headline: Woman uses Meta smart glasses and ChatGPT in an alleged witness-intimidation campaign
candidates.reason: This is a crime with a victim, and only a Fox News video page was found.

candidates.headline: NASA study of Kuiper Belt dust points to ancient heavy-oxygen ice reservoir
candidates.reason: The only pages found were NASA's own and a Phys.org page dated about 9 days before the scan, so it is likely outside the window. There is no second accepted news page, and it is an incremental finding.

candidates.headline: Verstappen wins Las Vegas Grand Prix
candidates.reason: A routine race win by a Dutch driver, not a record or a distinct achievement.
